notes_for_editor: Very thin record: the state list entry (coordinates, elevation 149, tag gfc-834), the Wikipedia article on the community of Manor, and the GFC history for the Ware Hotel context. The brief's elevation_m of 45.4 matches 149 feet. The name 'manor' is the list author's own label (entry 132 is above 72). The gfc-834 tag matches the brief's 'GFC US 834' register number, but no source explains the tag. The list's coordinates sit south-east of the community's centre point in Wikipedia; that is expected for a tower site and is not treated as a conflict. Web searches found nothing on this tower's build, staffing, status or access; a government auction listing for a different Ware County GFC tower (Bickley, list entry GA131, marked to be removed) came up and was not used. Worth asking the Georgia Forestry Commission about this tower and whether it stands.
